pairs.target: ruǎn héng shōudào hé lù suǒ huí zhǐ shí , zhèngzài bǔxié .
pairs.english: When Ruan Heng received the Joint Routes Office's reply, he was mending a shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡收到合路所回纸时，正在补鞋。

pairs.target: xiàn cóng zhēn yǎnlǐ huá chūqù sānhuí , tā suǒxìng ràng xié liúzài xī shàng , xiāndú xìn .
pairs.english: The thread slipped out of the needle's eye three times, so he simply left the shoe on his knee and read the letter first.
pairs.hanzi: 线从针眼里滑出去三回，他索性让鞋留在膝上，先读信。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài duìmiàn , shǒulǐ niē zhe zuóyè miáohǎo de chuāng kǎn tú , yuányǐwéi jīnrì néng zài shàngqù , què jiàn ruǎn héng dú dào yíbàn , jiāng nà yè fàng huí zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi sat opposite holding last night's sill drawing, expecting to go up again today, but halfway through reading Ruan Heng put the page back on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在对面，手里捏着昨夜描好的窗槛图，原以为今日能再上去，却见阮衡读到一半，将那页放回桌上。

pairs.target: " níng qí yào lái . " tā shuō , " hái dé sāntiān . wǒmen xiān zuò xiàmiàn zhè yíduàn . "
pairs.english: “Ningqi is coming,” he said. “Three days yet. We'll work on the stretch below first.”
pairs.hanzi: “宁岐要来。”他说，“还得三天。我们先做下面这一段。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi tīng guò zhège míngzì . yù hé shuō tā chá guò hǎojǐchù jiù zhuǎnyùn jià , bǐ ruǎn héng gèng kěn pá , yě bǐ tā gèng kěn jiào rén xiàlái .
pairs.english: Tavi had never heard the name. Yuhe said she had inspected several old transfer frames, more willing than Ruan Heng to climb and also more willing to order people down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没听过这个名字。郁禾说她查过好几处旧转运架，比阮衡更肯爬，也比他更肯叫人下来。

pairs.target: huí zhǐ gěi tā liè le yào kàn de zhīzuò hé jiù tú , méi ràng rènhérén kāitōng cháng kuà ; yuánxiān nà xiàng jiēkǒu jiǎnchá réng shì tāmen de huó .
pairs.english: The reply listed the supports and old plans she was to examine, authorizing nobody to open the long span; the original street-entrance inspection remained their job.
pairs.hanzi: 回纸给她列了要看的支座和旧图，没让任何人开通长跨；原先那项街口检查仍是他们的活。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ xiédǐ fānguòlái , chóngxīn chuānzhēn , hūrán wèn yù hé , zìjǐ shìbushì zhēn yǒu nàme ài wǎngshàngpá .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng turned the sole over, rethreaded the needle, and suddenly asked Yuhe whether he really did love climbing that much.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡把鞋底翻过来，重新穿针，忽然问郁禾，自己是不是真有那么爱往上爬。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiànzài hái diànjì chuāngwài nà jǐgēn duàn zuò ma ? "
pairs.english: “Are you still thinking about those broken supports outside the window?”
pairs.hanzi: “你现在还惦记窗外那几根断座吗？”

pairs.target: " diànjì . "
pairs.english: “Yes.”
pairs.hanzi: “惦记。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù bié wèn le . "
pairs.english: “Then don't ask.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就别问了。”

pairs.target: wǔhòu shū yàn lái qǐng tāmen qù cāng qián de chápéng . jǐjiā cāng xíng de rén yào tóng jiēshàng de zhùhù dāng miàntán , dé yǒurén shuō qīngchē jiūjìng kǎ zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: That afternoon Shuyan invited them to the tea shelter before the warehouses. Several warehouse firms wanted to meet street residents face to face, and someone needed to explain exactly where the carts got stuck.
pairs.hanzi: 午后舒砚来请他们去仓前的茶棚。几家仓行的人要同街上的住户当面谈，得有人说清车究竟卡在哪里。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng dài zhe jìlù , tǎ wéi ná tú gēn qù , dào le cái fāxiàn yǐzi búgòu , màichá de xiǎohuǒ yòu cóng pángbiān jiè le liǎngzhāng , zuòxià shí gāodī chà le bàngè tóu .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng brought records and Tavi followed with the diagram. On arrival they found too few chairs; the young tea seller borrowed two nearby, leaving the seated people half a head apart in height.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡带着记录，塔维拿图跟去，到了才发现椅子不够，卖茶的小伙又从旁边借了两张，坐下时高低差了半个头。

pairs.target: nàwèi sòng liánmíng qǐngqiú de hè zhǎngguì zuòzài kào wài de yìzhāng .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He, who had sent the joint request, sat on an outer chair.
pairs.hanzi: 那位送联名请求的贺掌柜坐在靠外的一张。

pairs.target: tā yuēmo sìshí lái suì , zhǐjié shàng zhān zhe xǐ bú jìng de diàn sè , shuōhuà qián xiān jiāng zhuōshàng liángchá yìkǒu hēwán , wèn shuí bǎ zìjǐ de chē tíng dào chápéng hòutou le , xièwán jiù zǒu , bié děng tā jiǎngwán zài mó .
pairs.english: She was about forty, indigo stains ingrained in her knuckles. Before speaking she drained the cold tea and asked who had parked her cart behind the shelter: unload and leave, no waiting until her talk ended to dawdle.
pairs.hanzi: 她约莫四十来岁，指节上沾着洗不净的靛色，说话前先将桌上凉茶一口喝完，问谁把自己的车停到茶棚后头了，卸完就走，别等她讲完再磨。

pairs.target: tā búshì zhī shōu zìjǐ de huò . wài pō jīnnián tóu yìpī gān jūn yǐyǒu rén bèi dào zhōngzhuǎnzhàn , yuē hǎo de shōuhuò rìzi yí dào , cāng xíng bù gěiqián , rénjiā jiù dé lìng zhǎo mǎizhǔ .
pairs.english: She did not buy only her own goods. The year's first dried mushrooms from the outer slopes had already been carried to the transfer station; if the warehouse firms did not pay on the agreed collection date, the suppliers would need other buyers.
pairs.hanzi: 她不是只收自己的货。外坡今年头一批干菌已有人背到中转站，约好的收货日子一到，仓行不给钱，人家就得另找买主。

pairs.target: biéde shānkǒu yě zài shōu , cuòguòqù , zhè yíjì de chē biàn wèibì zài lái zhé tóng .
pairs.english: Other mountain passes were buying too; miss the chance and this season's carts might not return to Zhetong.
pairs.hanzi: 别的山口也在收，错过去，这一季的车便未必再来折桐。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì ràng tāmen zǒu fēngdiào de cháng kuà . " tā zhǐzhǐ tú ,
pairs.english: “I'm not asking them to use the closed long span.” She pointed to the diagram.
pairs.hanzi: “我不是让他们走封掉的长跨。”她指指图，

pairs.target: " xiān kàn cāng hòu zhè duàn néng bunéng yún gěi cháng chē , ménqián shǎo bān liǎnghuí , huò yě shǎo huài liǎnghuí . gǎi lán de qián wǒmen chū , ruò yào qǐng rén guǎn shíchén , yě kěyǐ suàn . "
pairs.english: “First see whether the stretch behind the warehouses can accommodate long carts. Less carrying at the doors means less damage. We'll pay to move barriers; hiring someone to manage times can be included too.”
pairs.hanzi: “先看仓后这段能不能匀给长车，门前少搬两回，货也少坏两回。改栏的钱我们出，若要请人管时辰，也可以算。”

pairs.target: bì lán zuòzài lìngyìduān , xiùkǒu háiyǒu yìdiǎn méi nǐnggān de shuǐ .
pairs.english: Bilan sat at the other end, a little water still clinging to her unwrung cuffs.
pairs.hanzi: 碧岚坐在另一端，袖口还有一点没拧干的水。

pairs.target: tā shuō chūqián de rén ruò yě guǎn fàngxíng , rǎnfáng jǐshígè rén chīfàn de shíchén shìbushì dōu dé gēnzhe chēgǎi .
pairs.english: She asked whether, if the people paying also controlled passage, mealtimes for dozens at the dye works would have to change with the carts.
pairs.hanzi: 她说出钱的人若也管放行，染坊几十个人吃饭的时辰是不是都得跟着车改。

pairs.target: pángbiān kāi záhuòpù de nánrén quèshuō , zhǐyào dìng dé qīng , tā yuànyì bǎ zǎojiān jìnhuò wǎnghòu fàng ; chē shǎo dǔ yìhuí , tājiā de mén yě néng duō kāi bànshàn .
pairs.english: A man who ran a general store beside her said that with clear arrangements he would delay his morning deliveries; one fewer jam meant his doorway could open half a leaf wider.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边开杂货铺的男人却说，只要定得清，他愿意把早间进货往后放；车少堵一回，他家的门也能多开半扇。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén jiēzhe shuō , tǎ wéi yìshí bù zhīdào gāi kàn shuí .
pairs.english: Several people continued talking, and for a moment Tavi did not know whom to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人接着说，塔维一时不知道该看谁。

pairs.target: qiántiān zài lùkǒu shì chē hé rén jǐ zài yìqǐ , yǎnxià měigè rén dōu zuò zhe , huà què hái zài hùxiāng dǎng .
pairs.english: Two days ago people and carts had crowded the junction. Now everyone was seated, but their words still blocked one another.
pairs.hanzi: 前天在路口是车和人挤在一起，眼下每个人都坐着，话却还在互相挡。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn hè zhǎngguì shuō wǎnghòu xiū shànglù de fèiyòng zǒngděi yǒurén fēndān , yě tīngjiàn záhuòpù nánrén wèn , fēndān wán , huì buhuì zhī shèng chū dé qǐ qián de rén néng zǒu .
pairs.english: He heard Shopkeeper He say someone must share future upper-road repair costs, and the general-store man ask whether, afterward, only those able to pay would be able to use it.
pairs.hanzi: 他听见贺掌柜说往后修上路的费用总得有人分担，也听见杂货铺男人问，分担完，会不会只剩出得起钱的人能走。

pairs.target: shū yàn jiāng cháwǎn nuókāi , xiān wèn xiànzài zhè yíjì , búràng tāmen bǎ shínián hòu de shì dōu yā zài yìzhāng zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Shuyan moved the teacups aside and asked first about the present season, keeping them from piling ten years' future onto one table.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚将茶碗挪开，先问现在这一季，不让他们把十年后的事都压在一张桌上。

pairs.target: shuízhī hè zhǎngguì fǎnér bù gāoxìng , shuō huò zhī àn yíjì shōu , xiūlù què bùnéng yòng yíjì , ruò bùkěn tán hòutou de qián , jīnrì lái zhèlǐ tán shénme .
pairs.english: Unexpectedly Shopkeeper He was displeased: goods were bought by the season, but road repairs lasted longer; if future funding was off limits, what were they here to discuss?
pairs.hanzi: 谁知贺掌柜反而不高兴，说货只按一季收，修路却不能用一季，若不肯谈后头的钱，今日来这里谈什么。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng ràng tǎ wéi tānkāi zhuǎnwān tú . tā shuō le cháng xiāng wèishénme méi xiè , yòu shuō hòutou jǐ zhù shíjiē de shì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had Tavi spread the turning diagram. Tavi explained why the long crate was not unloaded, then how the crowd behind had blocked the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡让塔维摊开转弯图。他说了长箱为什么没卸，又说后头挤住石阶的事。

pairs.target: jiǎng dào wǔjiān fàng chē , tā shùnzuǐ tiān le yíjù , yěxǔ néng shì .
pairs.english: Coming to midday cart access, he casually added that perhaps they could try it.
pairs.hanzi: 讲到午间放车，他顺嘴添了一句，也许能试。

pairs.target: bì lán kànzhe tā : " zhōngwǔ shuí lái lán ? wǒ nàshí háiyào sòngfàn . "
pairs.english: Bilan looked at him. “Who manages the barrier at noon? I'm still delivering food then.”
pairs.hanzi: 碧岚看着他：“中午谁来拦？我那时还要送饭。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn shuō hái méi wèn wán , búshì yǐ dìng de bànfǎ .
pairs.english: Tavi hastily said he had not finished asking people; it was no settled proposal.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧说还没问完，不是已定的办法。

pairs.target: tā ěrgēn yǒuxiē rè , hè zhǎngguì què còu guòlái kàn tú , wèn rúguǒ liú gè néng huítóu de wèizhì , chē shìbushì búbì yí jìnlái jiù wǎngqián jǐ .
pairs.english: His ears felt warm, but Shopkeeper He leaned in to inspect the diagram, asking whether space to turn back would mean carts need not push forward as soon as they entered.
pairs.hanzi: 他耳根有些热，贺掌柜却凑过来看图，问如果留个能回头的位置，车是不是不必一进来就往前挤。

pairs.target: yù hé yòng shǒuyā zhù tú jiǎo , shuō chǐcùn háiyào zài liáng , bùnéng zhī píng zhè yíliàng .
pairs.english: Yuhe held the diagram's corner down and said they still needed measurements, not just this single cart.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾用手压住图角，说尺寸还要再量，不能只凭这一辆。

pairs.target: chá liáng le liǎnghuí , méi tán chéng nǎtiáo lù cóngcǐ guī shuí .
pairs.english: The tea went cold twice, without agreement on who would own which road from then on.
pairs.hanzi: 茶凉了两回，没谈成哪条路从此归谁。

pairs.target: shū yàn jìxià gèjiā yuànyì ràngchū de jùtǐ dìfāng , shuō níng qí lái le zài zǒuyíbiàn ;
pairs.english: Shuyan noted the specific spaces each household would offer and said they would walk it again after Ningqi arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚记下各家愿意让出的具体地方，说宁岐来了再走一遍；

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì yào liúzài jìlù shàng , chūqián bù děngyú tì suǒyǒurén mǎixià lùkǒu , bì lán yě jiānchí guǎn shíchén de rén bùnéng zhī tīng cāng xíng yìbiān .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He wanted it recorded that paying did not mean buying the junction for everyone; Bilan also insisted whoever managed times must not answer only to the warehouse firms.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜要留在记录上，出钱不等于替所有人买下路口，碧岚也坚持管时辰的人不能只听仓行一边。

pairs.target: chū le chápéng , tǎ wéi hái xiǎngzhe lòudiào de yíjù , ruǎn héng què jiāng tú tǒng dìgěi tā , shuō jīnrì dào zhèlǐ , màichá de yǐjīng tiān le bàn hú běn bùgāi tiān de shuǐ .
pairs.english: Leaving the shelter, Tavi still thought about something he had omitted. Ruan Heng handed him the tube and said that was enough for today; the tea seller had already added half a pot more water than he should have.
pairs.hanzi: 出了茶棚，塔维还想着漏掉的一句，阮衡却将图筒递给他，说今日到这里，卖茶的已经添了半壶本不该添的水。

pairs.target: liǎng rén yánjiē zǒukāi , tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā yào jiǎng zìjǐ fāngcái nǎlǐ shuōcuò , ruǎn héng xiān tíng zài xié tānqián , dītóu kàn le kàn zhēnjiǎo .
pairs.english: They walked away along the street. Tavi expected him to discuss what he had said wrong, but Ruan Heng first stopped at a shoe stall and looked down at his stitching.
pairs.hanzi: 两人沿街走开，塔维以为他要讲自己方才哪里说错，阮衡先停在鞋摊前，低头看了看针脚。

pairs.target: " wǒ bǔ wāi le . " tā shuō , " zuòzài nàlǐ bàntiān , jiǎo yìzhí wǎng wài huá . "
pairs.english: “I sewed it crooked,” he said. “All that time sitting there, my foot kept slipping outward.”
pairs.hanzi: “我补歪了。”他说，“坐在那里半天，脚一直往外滑。”
